title: Java Script Function Parameters
text:
JavaScript Function Parameters



Parameters (Function Input)

Parameters
allow you to pass (send) values to a function.

Parameters
are listed
inside the parentheses
in the function
definition
.

Functions with One Parameter

A function can have one parameter.

Functions with Multiple Parameters

You can add as many parameters as you want, separated by commas.

Parameters vs. Arguments

In JavaScript, function
parameters
and
arguments
are distinct concepts:

Parameters
are the
names
listed in the
function definition
.

Arguments
are the
real values
passed to, and
received by the function
.

Learn More:

Function Arguments

Parameter Rules

JavaScript function definitions
do not specify data types
for parameters.

JavaScript functions
do not perform type checking
on the arguments.

JavaScript functions
do not check the number
of arguments received.

Default Parameter Values

ECMAScript 2015
allows function parameters to have default values.

The default value is used if no argument is provided.

Function Return Values

A function can
return a value
back to the code that called it

The
return statement
is used to return a value from a function
